scripts.text:
[Housewife Marianne]
Whew...!
Still, he won't eat anything unless it's Meat. But maybe he will eat fruit if it was cut so that it was easy to eat. Like, if it was blended into juice...
scripts.translation:
[玛丽安太太]
呼...!
不过，他只肯吃肉。也许把水果切成方便入口的小块，他就愿意吃了，比如打成果汁...

scripts.text:
[Housewife Marianne]
Ah! Come to think of it, I heard they were making fruit juice somewhere. Now where was it... Payon Village, or Morocc?
scripts.translation:
[玛丽安太太]
啊！说起来，我听说有个地方在做果汁。是在哪里来着...斐扬村，还是梦罗克？

scripts.text:
[Housewife Marianne]
Morrison!! Eat some fruits!! You don't want to become a slobby fat pig when you grow up, do you?
scripts.translation:
[玛丽安太太]
莫里森！！快吃点水果！！你长大后可不想变成邋遢的胖猪吧？

scripts.text: Talk
scripts.translation: 交谈

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Housewife Marianne]
Hm? ...You!
You're the one who gave, my little Morrison that Meat?! Did you come here thinking I wouldn't know about it?!
scripts.translation:
[玛丽安太太]
嗯？...是你！
就是你给我家小莫里森肉吃的？！你以为我会不知道吗？！

scripts.text:
[Housewife Marianne]
Go away, get out of my house NOW!!
scripts.translation:
[玛丽安太太]
滚出去，现在马上滚出我家！！

scripts.text:
[Housewife Marianne]
Morrison!! I'm going to be very very mad if you keep doing this!
scripts.translation:
[玛丽安太太]
莫里森！！你要是再这样，我可要大发雷霆了！

scripts.text:
[Housewife Marianne]
Oh!!.... This...
what is this...??
How could you do something like this to my boy?!
scripts.translation:
[玛丽安太太]
啊！！...这...
这是什么...？
你怎么能对我儿子做这种事？！

scripts.text:
[Housewife Marianne]
Argh! Get out of my house right this instant!
scripts.translation:
[玛丽安太太]
Argh! 现在马上给我滚出家门！

scripts.text:
[Housewife Marianne]
Morrison!! Please eat some fruits!! Please~!
scripts.translation:
[玛丽安太太]
莫里森！！求你吃点水果吧！！拜托了~！

scripts.text:
[Housewife Marinaa]
Sigh~!! Like father, like son...
scripts.translation:
[玛丽安太太]
叹气~!! 真是有其父必有其子...

scripts.text: Talk
scripts.translation: 交谈

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Housewife Marianne]
*Sigh*... This is Morrison...
My one and only son.
scripts.translation:
[玛丽安太太]
*叹气*...这就是莫里森...
我唯一的儿子。

scripts.text:
[Housewife Marianne]
But these days, he just won't eat fruits. His face is so dull because he refuses to eat healthy. He just wants to eat Meat. I need to find a way to feed him fruits or vegetables....
scripts.translation:
[玛丽安太太]
可最近他就是不肯吃水果。因为不肯吃健康的食物，他的脸色都变差了。他只想吃肉。我得想办法让他吃水果或蔬菜...

scripts.text:
[Housewife Marianne]
Morrison!! You're going to be in big trouble if you keep this up!
scripts.translation:
[玛丽安太太]
莫里森！！你再这样下去可要惹上大麻烦了！

scripts.text:
[Little Morrison]
Bleh... Forget it.
I'm just going to shrivel to death just eating fruits. Don't bother worrying about me .
scripts.translation:
[小莫里森]
Bleh...算了。
光吃水果我会瘦成干的。别替我操心。

scripts.text:
[Little Morrison]
Ah... so full~
I think I can live now.
You don't have to give me any more Meat. I feel like I'm going to explode if I eat any more.
scripts.translation:
[小莫里森]
啊...好饱~
我想我这下能活下去了。
不用再给我肉了，再吃下去我就要撑爆了。

scripts.text:
[Little Morrison]
Oh... and... um.
Take this.
scripts.translation:
[小莫里森]
哦...还有...那个。
拿着这个。

scripts.text:
[Little Morrison]
It's a little something I've been saving to eat for later, but since you gave me Meat, I think I can pass on the sweets.
scripts.translation:
[小莫里森]
这是我留着以后吃的小零食，不过既然你给了我肉，我想甜食就可以让给你了。

scripts.text:
[Little Morrison]
Agh....Noooo!!!
No, don't make me eat it! I can't bear to taste fruits!
scripts.translation:
[小莫里森]
Agh....Noooo!!!
不，别逼我吃！我受不了水果的味道！

scripts.text: Talk
scripts.translation: 交谈

scripts.text: Show the Meat
scripts.translation: 出示肉

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Little Morrison]
Aaaagh!! Once or twice is enough!! I refuse to eat any more fruits! You have to peel them and there's so much juice that it makes you feel icky...
scripts.translation:
[小莫里森]
Aaaagh!! 吃一两次就够了！！我再也不吃水果了！还得剥皮，汁水又多，弄得人黏糊糊的...

scripts.text:
[Little Morrison]
And they're all slippery and sour... Even if I eat it, I still feel hungry. Aaaah~! Give me Meat!
scripts.translation:
[小莫里森]
而且水果又滑又酸...就算吃了，我还是觉得饿。Aaaah~!~！给我肉！

scripts.text:
[Little Morrison]
Ooh! M-Meaaat~
Ah... hu...hungry...
The scent of Meat...
Excuse me...
C-can I please have one?
scripts.translation:
[小莫里森]
噢！肉...肉~
啊...好...好饿...
肉的香味...
打扰了...
能...能给我一块吗？

scripts.text: Give Meat
scripts.translation: 给肉

scripts.text: Don't Give Meat
scripts.translation: 不给肉

scripts.text:
[Little Morrison]
Wow~!!! Meat!!
So yummy!
Thank you,
I think I can
live now.
*Chew chew*
scripts.translation:
[小莫里森]
哇~！！！肉！！
太好吃了！
谢谢你，
我想我现在
能活下去了。
*嚼嚼 嚼嚼*

scripts.text:
[Little Morrison]
Waah...!
Fine, I get it now.
Adults are all the same!
scripts.translation:
[小莫里森]
Waah...!...！
好吧，我懂了。
大人都一个样！

scripts.text:
[Little Morrison]
Aaaaah!!! No matter what, I'm not going to eat fruits and vegetables!
scripts.translation:
[小莫里森]
Aaaaah!!! 不管怎样，我就是不吃水果和蔬菜！

scripts.text:
[Merchant Marx Hansen]
Welcome.
Did you come to
process fruits as well?
scripts.translation:
[商人马克斯·汉森]
欢迎光临。
您也是来加工水果的吗？

scripts.text: Make Juice.
scripts.translation: 制作果汁

scripts.text: Talk and get information about fruit processing.
scripts.translation: 交谈，了解水果加工方式

scripts.text: Cancel.
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Merchant Marx Hansen]
What kind of fruit juice would you like to make?
scripts.translation:
[商人马克斯·汉森]
您想制作哪种果汁？

scripts.text: Apple Juice
scripts.translation: 苹果汁

scripts.text: Banana Juice
scripts.translation: 香蕉汁

scripts.text: Carrot Juice
scripts.translation: 胡萝卜汁

scripts.text: Grape Juice
scripts.translation: 葡萄汁

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Merchant Marx Hansen]
Well then...
See you next time.
scripts.translation:
[商人马克斯·汉森]
那么...
下次再见。

scripts.text:
[Merchant Marx Hansen]
Oh no...
You don't have all the necessary materials. To make {0}, I need 1 {1} and 1 Empty Bottle. I will also need a 3 zeny fee.
scripts.translation:
[商人马克斯·汉森]
哎呀...
您没有备齐所需材料。制作{0}需要1个{1}和1个空瓶，另外还要支付3 Zeny。

scripts.text:
[Merchant Marx Hansen]
When you have prepared everything, I will blend the fruit to give you delicious juice.
scripts.translation:
[商人马克斯·汉森]
备齐材料后，我就把水果榨成果汁给您。

scripts.text:
[Merchant Marx Hansen]
How many would you like?
scripts.translation:
[商人马克斯·汉森]
您想制作多少瓶？

scripts.text: As many as I can.
scripts.translation: 尽可能多地制作

scripts.text: I want a certain amount.
scripts.translation: 指定数量

scripts.text: Cancel.
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Merchant Marx Hansen]
Choose a number less than 100. If you don't want to, put '0'. You can make up to {0} bottles of juice.
scripts.translation:
[商人马克斯·汉森]
请输入小于100的数量。如果不制作，请输入“0”。您最多可以制作{0}瓶果汁。

scripts.text:
[Merchant Marx Hansen]
Well then...
Come again.
scripts.translation:
[商人马克斯·汉森]
那么...
欢迎再来。

scripts.text:
[Merchant Marx Hansen]
More than 100 bottles is impossible. Choose a different amount.
scripts.translation:
[商人马克斯·汉森]
超过100瓶是不可能的，请重新选择数量。

scripts.text:
[Merchant Marx Hansen]
Well then...
Come again.
scripts.translation:
[商人马克斯·汉森]
那么...
欢迎再来。

scripts.text:
[Merchant Marx Hansen]
Oh no...
You don't have all the necessary materials. I can't help a situation like this. I guess you collect what you need.
scripts.translation:
[商人马克斯·汉森]
哎呀...
您没有备齐所需材料，这种情况我也帮不上忙。把需要的材料收集齐再来吧。

scripts.text:
[Merchant Marx Hansen]
Here you go! Fresh and delicious juice as promised. It should be very refreshing and palatable.
scripts.translation:
[商人马克斯·汉森]
给您！这是答应您的新鲜美味果汁，清爽可口。

scripts.text:
[Merchant Marx Hansen]
Well then...
Come again.
scripts.translation:
[商人马克斯·汉森]
那么...
欢迎再来。

scripts.text:
[Merchant Marx Hansen]
Before humans were able to develop such vast societies, they gathered fruit from trees to survive. Fruits may have been nature's blessing that allowed us to exist in the world.
scripts.translation:
[商人马克斯·汉森]
在人类建立起庞大的社会之前，人们靠采摘树上的果实维生。水果或许是大自然的恩赐，让我们得以在世上生存。

scripts.text:
[Merchant Marx Hansen]
Since life became so prosperous, the younger generation seems not to eat fruit any more. So, I started thinking of ways to make fruit easier to eat.
scripts.translation:
[商人马克斯·汉森]
如今生活富足，年轻一代似乎不再吃水果了。所以我开始琢磨，怎样才能让水果更方便食用。

scripts.text:
[Merchant Marx Hansen]
I realized that when you make fruit juice, it's more convenient to eat and has a much better taste.
scripts.translation:
[商人马克斯·汉森]
我发现，把水果做成果汁，不仅食用起来更方便，味道也更好。
